ConfigurableProduct:17396.faq:
How do I wash my patterned Dog Collar?

We recommend popping your dog collar in the washing machine on a cold cycle. Alternatively, you can hand-wash it in the sink with some soap.

Which Size Collar Will Fit My Dog?

We recommend you measure your dog's neck & choose your collar size based on the measurements: Extra Small Collar: 24-35cm long. If your dog's neck measures larger than 35cms around, you will need a small or large collar. Small Collar: 29-44cm long. If your dog's neck measures larger than 44cms around, you will need a large collar. Large Collar: 39-64cm long. If your dog's neck measures less than 39 cms around, you might like to try the small patterned collar. If your dog's neck measures more than 64cms around, you may have mistaken a horse for your dog. Unfortunately, we do not have any collars that measure larger than 64cms in length at this stage.

What are the buckles & clasps made from?

The buckle & adjustment clasp on these custom Dog Collars are made from durable plastic. They're both lightweight & rust-proof.

What does the inside of the Dog Collar look like?

The inside of our Dog Collars are black so it's super easy to keep them looking clean while your dog is wearing it.

What material is this Dog Collar made from?

Our Dog Collars are made from a durable woven polyester webbing. They're super tough, washable, lightweight & soft to wear.

Will the Dog Bandanas fit all of the collar sizes?

Unfortunately, our Dog Bandanas are designed to fit only the Small Dog Collar, as the Large Collars are too wide to slide through. Additionally, the Bandanas are too big to be used with the XS Collar. However, you can easily use a piece of ribbon to tie the Bandana comfortably around your dog’s neck.
